title: Figure 8. Predicted Relic GW Energy Density as a Function of Frequency
description: Log-log plot of relic gravitational wave energy density Ωgw(ν) (10^-14 to 10^-2) versus frequency ν in Hz (10^-20 to 10^10), with curves labeled "Ωgw, n = 1.2", "Ωgw, n = 1.0" and "Thermal, T=2 K". Vertical bands mark detection regimes: "CMB anisotropies in temperature & polarization", "millisecond pulsars", "space-based interferometers", "ground-based interferometers" and "high frequency g.w. detectors". Source attributed in text to Grishchuk (2008).
